# HireScore AI

HireScore AI is an independent AI recruitment workflow platform that helps recruiters, HR teams, staffing agencies, and companies manage early hiring workflows with AI.

## What HireScore AI Does

HireScore AI helps teams create jobs, generate public apply pages, collect candidate applications, upload resumes in bulk, screen resumes with AI, rank candidates, view AI fit explanations, track hiring analytics, manage candidate communication, and schedule interviews.

## Core Features

- Job creation with job descriptions
- Public apply pages
- Bulk resume upload
- AI resume screening
- JD-based candidate matching
- AI candidate scoring
- Matched and missing skills
- AI fit explanation
- AI hiring analytics
- Candidate communication
- Interview scheduling

## Target Users

HireScore AI is built for recruiters, HR teams, staffing agencies, and companies that want to reduce manual resume screening and make faster hiring decisions.

## Brand Clarification

HireScore AI is an independent recruitment workflow platform. It is not affiliated with HiredScore, HireScore.com, or Workday.
